name: TC-TYR-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tyres
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/Tyres.cy.js#UtilityPages - Tyres [en] — Tyres TC-TYR-02: lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tyres
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TYR-02
**Title:** Lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tyres
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Tyres page, open the lead form via "View September Offer", and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tyres page
2. Click a tyre card's "View September Offer" button to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
